name: Keeping Healthy
overview: Scripture reveals that God has provided for our physical well-being by giving us natural foods for sustenance and health, as seen in His provision of herbs and fruit-bearing trees (Genesis 1:29). Obedience to God's commandments is linked to protection from disease, reflecting His role as the healer of His people (Exodus 15:26). Moreover, the Bible emphasizes the value of a sound heart and wholesome speech in promoting physical health, highlighting the connection between spiritual and bodily well-being (Proverbs 14:30; Proverbs 16:24). Recognizing that we are wonderfully made by God (Psalms 139:14) encourages humility and reverence for Him, which is foundational to living a healthy life (Proverbs 3:7).
